_doc: Site improvements shown under What's New in the Weekly Brief (new pages are detected automatically from git; list improvements to existing pages here). One entry per improvement: date (HST, YYYY-MM-DD, the day it went live), page (site-relative), what {en,fr,es,ar,it,he}. Facts only. An issue shows entries dated after the previous issue, up to the issue date. Auto-appended by scripts/newsletter-updates-sync.js (run in weekly-sync.sh) from commits 'feat(Page.html): reader-facing sentence' and NOTES.md '## Newsletter' bullets '- YYYY-MM-DD | Page.html | sentence'; auto entries are English-only until what.fr/es/ar are added.

what.en: Contact page: every department now has its own inbox, for general hellos, solution ideas, press, partnerships, teachers, error reports, privacy requests and translations.

New solution: International Charter: Space and Major Disasters. When disaster strikes, 17 space agencies and satellite operators pool their satellites and give free images to rescue teams. Activated 1,000 times.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: International Charter: Space and Major Disasters. When disaster strikes, 17 space agencies and satellite operators pool their satellites and give free images to rescue teams. Activated 1,000 times.

what.en: New solution: Copernicus EMS On-Demand Mapping. The European Union's emergency mapping service turns satellite images into maps for disaster teams, 24/7 since 2012, with more than 1,000 activations.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: Copernicus EMS On-Demand Mapping. The European Union's emergency mapping service turns satellite images into maps for disaster teams, 24/7 since 2012, with more than 1,000 activations.

what.en: New solution: FIRMS: NASA's Satellite Fire Map. NASA's FIRMS delivers satellite fire detections within 3 hours anywhere on Earth, and in real time for the US and Canada. Free for firefighters and everyone.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: FIRMS: NASA's Satellite Fire Map. NASA's FIRMS delivers satellite fire detections within 3 hours anywhere on Earth, and in real time for the US and Canada. Free for firefighters and everyone.

what.en: New solution: UNEP Methane Alert and Response System. The UN's satellite methane alert system has sent more than 3,500 alerts about major leaks in 33 countries, and responses rose from 1% to 12% in a year.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: UNEP Methane Alert and Response System. The UN's satellite methane alert system has sent more than 3,500 alerts about major leaks in 33 countries, and responses rose from 1% to 12% in a year.

what.en: New solution: The GLOBE Program: Student Earth Science. A worldwide science program where students and citizen scientists collect real environmental data: more than 293 million measurements from 127 countries.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: The GLOBE Program: Student Earth Science. A worldwide science program where students and citizen scientists collect real environmental data: more than 293 million measurements from 127 countries.

what.en: New solution: Argo Ocean Float Array. Close to 4,000 robotic floats dive through the ocean and send back temperature and salinity data, free to everyone. The 3 millionth profile came in 2024.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: Argo Ocean Float Array. Close to 4,000 robotic floats dive through the ocean and send back temperature and salinity data, free to everyone. The 3 millionth profile came in 2024.

what.en: New solution: Argos Satellite Tracking System. A satellite system that tracks wildlife and ocean instruments from tiny transmitters, following more than 8,000 animals every month for conservation science.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: Argos Satellite Tracking System. A satellite system that tracks wildlife and ocean instruments from tiny transmitters, following more than 8,000 animals every month for conservation science.

what.en: New solution: NOAA Coral Reef Watch: Bleaching Alerts. NOAA's Coral Reef Watch uses satellites to warn of the ocean heat that bleaches corals, with daily monitoring of 95% of the world's coral reefs.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: NOAA Coral Reef Watch: Bleaching Alerts. NOAA's Coral Reef Watch uses satellites to warn of the ocean heat that bleaches corals, with daily monitoring of 95% of the world's coral reefs.

what.en: New solution: RADARSAT Constellation Mission (Canada). Three Canadian radar satellites watch Canada's land, coasts and Arctic day and night, through cloud and smoke, with about 250,000 images a year.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: RADARSAT Constellation Mission (Canada). Three Canadian radar satellites watch Canada's land, coasts and Arctic day and night, through cloud and smoke, with about 250,000 images a year.

what.en: New solution: ATLAS Asteroid Last Alert System. Four robotic telescopes, two in Hawaiʻi, search the entire dark sky every 24 hours for asteroids that could hit Earth, so people can be warned.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: ATLAS Asteroid Last Alert System. Four robotic telescopes, two in Hawaiʻi, search the entire dark sky every 24 hours for asteroids that could hit Earth, so people can be warned.

what.en: New solution: Pan-STARRS Near-Earth Object Search. Two telescopes on Haleakalā, Maui, that in 2021 found nearly as many near-Earth objects as the rest of the world's observatories combined.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: Pan-STARRS Near-Earth Object Search. Two telescopes on Haleakalā, Maui, that in 2021 found nearly as many near-Earth objects as the rest of the world's observatories combined.

what.en: New solution: Catalina Sky Survey: Asteroid Hunters. A NASA-funded survey in Arizona that has discovered more near-Earth objects than any other: 17,918 near-Earth asteroids since 1995.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: Catalina Sky Survey: Asteroid Hunters. A NASA-funded survey in Arizona that has discovered more near-Earth objects than any other: 17,918 near-Earth asteroids since 1995.

what.en: New solution: ESA Near-Earth Object Coordination Centre. Europe's asteroid watch centre computes orbits and impact risks every day and keeps a public list of every asteroid with a non-zero chance of hitting Earth.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: ESA Near-Earth Object Coordination Centre. Europe's asteroid watch centre computes orbits and impact risks every day and keeps a public list of every asteroid with a non-zero chance of hitting Earth.

what.en: New solution: EFFIS: European Forest Fire Information System. Europe's wildfire system forecasts fire danger and maps burnt areas from satellites. In 2024 it mapped wildfires in 42 countries.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: EFFIS: European Forest Fire Information System. Europe's wildfire system forecasts fire danger and maps burnt areas from satellites. In 2024 it mapped wildfires in 42 countries.

what.en: New solution: Joint Polar Satellite System (NOAA). NOAA's polar weather satellites circle Earth 14 times a day. Polar-orbiting satellites supply about 85% of the data used by weather prediction models.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: Joint Polar Satellite System (NOAA). NOAA's polar weather satellites circle Earth 14 times a day. Polar-orbiting satellites supply about 85% of the data used by weather prediction models.

what.en: New solution: GSMaP Global Rainfall Map (JAXA). JAXA's Global Satellite Mapping of Precipitation maps rain around the world every hour, used by 18,673 registered users in 163 countries and regions.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: GSMaP Global Rainfall Map (JAXA). JAXA's Global Satellite Mapping of Precipitation maps rain around the world every hour, used by 18,673 registered users in 163 countries and regions.

what.en: New solution: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service. Europe's air monitoring service forecasts air pollution, smoke and dust worldwide twice a day for more than 23,500 users, free and open.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service. Europe's air monitoring service forecasts air pollution, smoke and dust worldwide twice a day for more than 23,500 users, free and open.

what.en: New solution: GloFAS: Global Flood Awareness System. Free global river flood forecasts up to 30 days ahead, plus 4-month outlooks, from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: GloFAS: Global Flood Awareness System. Free global river flood forecasts up to 30 days ahead, plus 4-month outlooks, from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service.

what.en: New solution: Copernicus Marine Service: Free Ocean Data. Free, open ocean data and forecasts for the whole planet. In 2025 users downloaded almost 15,000 terabytes of ocean data from Copernicus Marine.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: Copernicus Marine Service: Free Ocean Data. Free, open ocean data and forecasts for the whole planet. In 2025 users downloaded almost 15,000 terabytes of ocean data from Copernicus Marine.

what.en: New solution: OpenET: Satellite Water Data for Farms. Free satellite data on how much water crops and land use, now for all 48 contiguous states, with more than 13,000 registered users.

entries.note: 2026-10-16|New solution: OpenET: Satellite Water Data for Farms. Free satellite data on how much water crops and land use, now for all 48 contiguous states, with more than 13,000 registered users.

what.en: The ALOS-4 page now covers JJ-FAST, the JICA and JAXA radar system that tracks tropical forest loss from ALOS-2 (updates limited to Brazil since April 2024).

entries.note: 2026-10-16|The ALOS-4 page now covers JJ-FAST, the JICA and JAXA radar system that tracks tropical forest loss from ALOS-2 (updates limited to Brazil since April 2024).

what.en: 12 new solutions, including Parker Solar Probe, The SeaCleaners and WeForest. Saving Planets now features 175 real solutions.
what.fr: 12 nouvelles solutions, dont Parker Solar Probe, The SeaCleaners et WeForest. Saving Planets présente désormais 175 solutions réelles.
what.es: 12 soluciones nuevas, entre ellas Parker Solar Probe, The SeaCleaners y WeForest. Saving Planets ya presenta 175 soluciones reales.
what.ar: 12 حلاً جديداً، منها Parker Solar Probe وThe SeaCleaners وWeForest. يعرض Saving Planets الآن 175 حلاً حقيقياً.
what.it: 12 nuove soluzioni, tra cui Parker Solar Probe, The SeaCleaners e WeForest. Saving Planets ora presenta 175 soluzioni reali.

what.en: New for kids: Space Passport. Collect a stamp for every part of Saving Planets you explore. Saved only on your device.
what.fr: Nouveau pour les enfants : le Passeport spatial. Collecte un tampon pour chaque partie de Saving Planets que tu explores. Enregistré seulement sur ton appareil.
what.es: Novedad para niños: el Pasaporte espacial. Consigue un sello por cada parte de Saving Planets que explores. Se guarda solo en tu dispositivo.
what.ar: جديد للأطفال: جواز السفر الفضائي. اجمع ختماً عن كل جزء تستكشفه من Saving Planets. يُحفظ على جهازك فقط.
what.it: Novità per i bambini: il Passaporto spaziale. Raccogli un timbro per ogni parte di Saving Planets che esplori. Salvato solo sul tuo dispositivo.
what.he: חדש לילדים: דרכון החלל. אספו חותמת על כל חלק ב-Saving Planets שאתם חוקרים. נשמר רק במכשיר שלכם.

what.en: New game: Myth or Fact? Evidence Arcade. Decide if each claim is a myth or a fact, then see the source that proves it.
what.fr: Nouveau jeu : Mythe ou réalité ? L’arcade des preuves. Décide si chaque affirmation est un mythe ou une réalité, puis découvre la source qui le prouve.
what.es: Juego nuevo: ¿Mito o realidad? La arcade de las pruebas. Decide si cada afirmación es un mito o una realidad y luego mira la fuente que lo demuestra.
what.ar: لعبة جديدة: خرافة أم حقيقة؟ لعبة الأدلة. قرّر إن كان كل ادعاء خرافة أم حقيقة، ثم شاهد المصدر الذي يثبت ذلك.
what.it: Nuovo gioco: Mito o realtà? L’arcade delle prove. Decidi se ogni affermazione è un mito o un fatto, poi guarda la fonte che lo dimostra.
what.he: משחק חדש: מיתוס או עובדה? ארקייד הראיות. החליטו אם כל טענה היא מיתוס או עובדה, ואז ראו את המקור שמוכיח זאת.

what.en: Launch Your Name: make a keepsake boarding pass for the next real rocket launch on our Launch Tracker. Your name is never saved or sent.
what.fr: Lance ton nom : crée une carte d’embarquement souvenir pour le prochain vrai lancement de fusée de notre suivi des lancements. Ton nom n’est jamais enregistré ni envoyé.
what.es: Lanza tu nombre: crea una tarjeta de embarque de recuerdo para el próximo lanzamiento real de nuestro seguimiento de lanzamientos. Tu nombre nunca se guarda ni se envía.
what.ar: أطلق اسمك: اصنع بطاقة صعود تذكارية لإطلاق الصاروخ الحقيقي التالي في متتبع الإطلاقات لدينا. لا يُحفظ اسمك ولا يُرسل أبداً.
what.it: Lancia il tuo nome: crea una carta d’imbarco ricordo per il prossimo vero lancio di un razzo del nostro tracker dei lanci. Il tuo nome non viene mai salvato né inviato.
what.he: שגרו את השם שלכם: הכינו כרטיס עלייה למזכרת לשיגור הטיל האמיתי הבא במעקב השיגורים שלנו. השם שלכם אף פעם לא נשמר ולא נשלח.

what.en: Superpowers panel on kids pages: Read to me, bigger text, an easy-read font, high contrast, calm motion and tap instead of drag. Saved only on your device.
what.fr: Panneau Super-pouvoirs sur les pages enfants : lecture à voix haute, texte plus grand, police facile à lire, contraste élevé, mouvements calmes et toucher au lieu de glisser. Enregistré seulement sur ton appareil.
what.es: Panel de Superpoderes en las páginas para niños: lectura en voz alta, texto más grande, letra fácil de leer, alto contraste, movimiento tranquilo y tocar en vez de arrastrar. Se guarda solo en tu dispositivo.
what.ar: لوحة القوى الخارقة في صفحات الأطفال: القراءة بصوت عالٍ، ونص أكبر، وخط سهل القراءة، وتباين عالٍ، وحركة هادئة، واللمس بدل السحب. تُحفظ على جهازك فقط.
what.it: Pannello Superpoteri nelle pagine per bambini: lettura ad alta voce, testo più grande, carattere facile da leggere, contrasto elevato, movimento calmo e tocco invece del trascinamento. Salvato solo sul tuo dispositivo.
what.he: לוח כוחות־על בדפי הילדים: הקראה, טקסט גדול יותר, גופן קל לקריאה, ניגודיות גבוהה, תנועה רגועה והקשה במקום גרירה. נשמר רק במכשיר שלכם.
